newsitem.title: USA: INTERVIEW-Interstate Hotels backs Q1 EPS est.
newsitem.headline: INTERVIEW-Interstate Hotels backs Q1 EPS est.

text.p: Interstate Hotels Co chief executive W. Thomas Parrington said he is comfortable with analysts' earnings estimates of $0.27 to $0.28 per share for the company's first quarter.
"We are very comfortable with that. We will equal or exceed the range," Parrington told Reuters in an interview.
Pittsburgh-based Interstate in the largest U.S. hotel management company and is scheduled to report results before the market open Thursday.
